Every length-b transition window has a unique phase for b>=3, so overlapping circular windows force n=0 mod b. Phase-aligned images uniquely desubstitute; rotations starting one symbol into a block are equivalent to all periodic source windows of length m+1. Short cases follow from the complete possible run lengths 1,b-1,b and the explicit ternary length-4 exception. Every quantifier and the n>=b+2 boundary has been checked; the standalone verifier agrees for bases 3..8 and lengths through 68.

value.rationale: Lie complexity is a recognized finer factor invariant for automatic words. The theorem determines an exact universal sharp support obstruction for every integer base b>=3 and constructs a bijective quotient to one-step source-factor windows for every surviving length, with complete exceptional initial cases and infinite families of nonvanishing multiples. This is a structural restriction not entailed by boundedness or automaticity, and the surviving mixed class at 2b shows that square counts are insufficient. The exact all-base congruence is the central value, independent of a full numerical evaluation at every multiple.
